_doc: CA Successor RDA tax-allocation-bond obligor universe for muni-credit detector framework
_purpose: Scope the ROPS-allocation-intercept masking mechanism. Test whether RDA bonds trade to ROPS-secured credit (Successor Agency rating dominant) or host-city general fund credit (host GO rating dominant). Apply refined-thesis lens: descend rating ladder while selecting quality issuers within rating bands.
_methodology: Compiled May 2026 from S&P rating reports (Atascadero 2024A surveillance), Bond Buyer coverage of post-dissolution issuance (Bunker Hill CRA/LA 2014, SJ SARA $1.34B 2017, Riverside SA 2014/2018, Hercules RDA 2012 default, San Bernardino JPFA downgrade 2012), CA Department of Finance ROPS portal, EMMA primary-source disclosures referenced via BondView CUSIP listings, and California Health & Safety Code statutory framework (§34177.5, §34183).
_caveats: (1) ~360 Successor Agencies exist statewide; this universe includes ~30 of the largest by outstanding par + critical positive controls (San Bernardino, Stockton, Vallejo, Hercules) for hostile validation. (2) Spread data is sparse for post-dissolution Successor RDA bonds because most trade infrequently; primary-market spreads at refunding (CSFA-style) are the main data anchor and were not pulled at scale in this 90-min scoping. (3) Many small Successor Agencies have only insured legacy bonds outstanding (AGM, BAM, NPFG, Assured) — the insurer wrap masks the ROPS intercept structurally; underlying credit shown where available. (4) Host-city GO rating sourced from multiple time points (mostly recent surveillance); GO ratings on Successor Agency cities are not always re-rated annually so timing alignment with TAB rating dates is approximate.

sector_size_estimate.outstanding_par_estimate_source: Bond Buyer 2014 commentary noted $1.2B refundings by 28 SAs in 2014 alone; aggregate $23.3B issued by pre-dissolution RDAs through 2011; substantial refundings 2014-2017 cycle. No single authoritative sector total found in 90-min scoping (CDIAC DebtWatch is the primary source but its sector-aggregate report was not extracted)
sector_size_estimate.ratings_dispersion_sp_2014_baseline: 70% A-category, 15% AA-minus, balance BBB or insurer-wrap (Bond Buyer 2014). Higher A-category share than charter (~50%) or hospital (~40%)
sector_size_estimate.ratings_dispersion_moodys_2012_baseline: Most rated Ba1 (junk); 12 of 63 still-rated credits investment-grade Baa3+; 31 withdrew (Bond Buyer 2012). Split-rating gap S&P vs Moody's is one of the widest in muni — direct evidence of methodology disagreement on ROPS intercept structure
sector_size_estimate.rating_agency_methodology_divergence: S&P treats as 'special-purpose district' / tax-increment credit, weights AV growth + DSCR + closed-lien + dissolution-law constraints. Moody's weights cash-flow volatility + DOF approval risk + lack of liquidity. Split rating creates structural pricing dispersion within issuer.

masking_mechanism_hypothesis.name: ROPS allocation intercept (post-dissolution Successor Agency tax-allocation framework)
masking_mechanism_hypothesis.structural_property: Per HSC §34183, county auditor-controller distributes RPTTF (former tax increment) in fixed waterfall: (1) statutory + pre-1994 pass-throughs to taxing entities, (2) TAB debt service per ROPS, (3) revenue bonds (if pledged), (4) admin allowance, (5) residual back to taxing entities. Per HSC §34177.5(e), refunding bonds can SUBORDINATE pass-throughs to debt service (45-day deemed-approval mechanism) — putting refunding-TAB bondholders FIRST in waterfall. DOF approval required for refunding issuance.
masking_mechanism_hypothesis.what_it_masks: Host city/county general fund stress. Successor Agency tax-allocation bonds are paid from RPTTF held in county trust, not host general fund. San Bernardino (BK 2012), Stockton (BK 2012), Vallejo (BK 2008) bondholders received uninterrupted debt service on TABs throughout host municipal bankruptcies because RPTTF is 'special revenue' under Bankruptcy Code §902(2).
masking_mechanism_hypothesis.what_it_does_NOT_mask: (1) Project-area AV decline / top-taxpayer concentration risk; (2) DOF rejection of obligations on ROPS (rare but a tail risk; Meet-and-Confer dispute path codified); (3) Project-area-specific economic shock (e.g., commercial vacancy in CBD-only project areas); (4) Hercules-style intra-agency fund-transfer fraud where RDA cash was diverted to city general fund pre-dissolution.
masking_mechanism_hypothesis.claims_pay_trigger: RPTTF semi-annual distribution date (Jun 1, Jan 2) by county auditor-controller direct to bond trustee, before host city receives any pass-through revenue.

rating_action_history_positive_controls.action: S&P A- -> BBB Aug 2012 on city BK filing
rating_action_history_positive_controls.interpretation: PARTIAL MASKING — rating cut on 'willingness to pay' concern despite no actual payment interruption. Spread widened but ratings stabilized post-emergence. Framework lesson: ratings do reflect host stress but lag actual default protection by structural ROPS intercept.

rating_action_history_positive_controls.issuer: Successor Agency to San Bernardino RDA TABs 2016
rating_action_history_positive_controls.interpretation: Recovered to A within 4 years of city BK; ROPS-secured credit re-rated to A despite host city's continued post-BK fiscal stress. STRONG EVIDENCE the rating is to project-area / ROPS credit, not host.

rating_action_history_positive_controls.action: Actual default Feb 1 2012 on $2.4M debt service; Ambac paid via surety reserve; Ambac sued city alleging illegal pre-dissolution diversion of tax increment to city general fund
rating_action_history_positive_controls.interpretation: ROPS structure NOT YET IN PLACE on Feb 1 2012 (dissolution date statutorily Feb 1 2012; first ROPS cycle Jan-Jun 2012). Pre-ROPS abuse-of-discretion case. Post-ROPS the diversion-to-city mechanism is structurally prevented by county auditor direct distribution.

rating_action_history_positive_controls.issuer: Successor Agency to Riverside RDA Desert Communities Project Area
rating_action_history_positive_controls.action: S&P BBB -> A- on Series 2014D issuance
rating_action_history_positive_controls.interpretation: Upgrade reflected project area AV growth. Rating moves on PROJECT AREA economic factors, not host city general fund.

masking_mechanism_hypothesis.predicted_severity: HIGH (analogous to Cal-Mortgage / CSFA LCFF intercept). ROPS bondholders structurally insulated from host fiscal stress.
masking_mechanism_hypothesis.predicted_alpha_implication: (1) Framework's host-city stress signals (general-fund deficit, pension underfunding, BK risk) do NOT translate to Successor Agency TAB spreads. Diligence-replication value but minimal price-discovery alpha. (2) Project-area AV trajectory + top-taxpayer concentration ARE the load-bearing signals (Atascadero S&P methodology). (3) Split-rating dispersion S&P vs Moody's creates a structural pricing inefficiency — buy S&P A- names that Moody's withdrew rather than rated junk.
masking_mechanism_hypothesis.framework_alpha_zone: Strong project-area + AV growth + low taxpayer concentration + closed-lien constraint + ROPS-eligible refunding TAB issued by host city with weaker GO rating. Spread reflects host noise but underlying credit is structural.

rops_waterfall_per_hsc_34183.basis: Statutory pass-throughs (Sections 33401, 33676, 33607.5/.7) and pre-1994 negotiated pass-through agreements
rops_waterfall_per_hsc_34183.subordinable_to_bonds: YES via §34177.5(e) refunding-bond subordination consent (45-day deemed approval)

rops_waterfall_per_hsc_34183.recipient: Successor Agency for ROPS-listed TAB debt service
rops_waterfall_per_hsc_34183.basis: Most senior TAB lien; refunding TABs use §34177.5(a) authority

rops_waterfall_per_hsc_34183.recipient: Successor Agency for ROPS-listed revenue bond debt service
rops_waterfall_per_hsc_34183.basis: Only if revenue insufficient AND tax increment pledged

rops_waterfall_per_hsc_34183.recipient: Successor Agency for ROPS-listed other enforceable obligations
rops_waterfall_per_hsc_34183.basis: Administrative cost allowance + contractually committed third-party obligations
Pro-rata to schools / county / city / special districts per §34188

obligors.notes: DOF DISPUTE PRECEDENT. Oakland is the canonical example of a host city that has litigated ROPS items denied by DOF. obligors.name: Successor Agency to the Hercules Redevelopment Agency
obligors.outstanding_par_source: Bond Buyer Hercules RDA default coverage; https://www.bondbuyer.com/news/ambac-sues-troubled-hercules-calif-after-rda-default
obligors.default_event: Feb 1, 2012 — $2.4M missed RDA TAB debt service; Ambac surety-bond pay; Ambac sued Hercules for illegal pre-dissolution diversion of tax-increment revenue to city general fund
obligors.project_areas: Hercules Redevelopment Project Area
obligors.rops_compliance_history: Pre-ROPS default. Dissolution was statutorily Feb 1, 2012 — same day as Hercules default. The default was a 'last-mile' RDA mismanagement event, not a ROPS-system failure.
obligors.notes: CRITICAL FALSIFIER ATTEMPT. Hercules is the ONE actual RDA TAB default in modern CA muni history (2012). If ROPS intercept is so masking, why did this default happen? Answer: it happened ON the dissolution date, before any ROPS distribution had occurred. The legal cause was pre-dissolution diversion of tax-increment cash from RDA to city general fund — exactly the abuse-of-discretion failure that the post-dissolution ROPS framework was DESIGNED TO PREVENT. POST-ROPS analog default = none observed in dataset 2012-2026. Important corroboration that the structural protection of the ROPS framework is BETTER than pre-2012 RDA structure was.

test_1_rating_resilience_through_host_bk.method: Compare Successor Agency TAB rating before, during, and after host city Chapter 9 (San Bernardino, Stockton). Compare to host GO rating trajectory over same period.
test_1_rating_resilience_through_host_bk.expected_if_masking: TAB rating cut <2 notches on host BK announcement; TAB rating recovers to A-category within 2-3 years post-emergence; host GO remains speculative-grade for 5+ years post-emergence
test_1_rating_resilience_through_host_bk.observed: San Bernardino TABs S&P A- -> BBB on city BK (1-notch cut); Fitch later A on same credit (2016 post-BK). Pattern matches PARTIAL MASKING — rating reflects host stress but cushion >2 notches preserved.

test_2_dof_rejection_actual_payment_disr.method: Search public records for ROPS items denied by DOF that caused actual TAB debt service interruption
test_2_dof_rejection_actual_payment_disr.expected_if_masking: Zero TAB payment interruptions from DOF rejection (since TAB debt service is Priority 2 in waterfall, structurally non-disputable)
test_2_dof_rejection_actual_payment_disr.observed: Zero documented in scoping. Oakland v. DOF (2022) litigation concerned non-TAB administrative items. Hercules 2012 pre-ROPS default does not count.

test_3_split_rating_dispersion.method: Compare Moody's vs S&P rating distribution on same TAB credits
test_3_split_rating_dispersion.expected_if_masking_is_real_but_methodol: S&P rates higher than Moody's (S&P uses special-purpose-district methodology; Moody's uses cash-flow volatility framework)
test_3_split_rating_dispersion.observed: S&P 70% A-category / 15% AA- (Bond Buyer 2014). Moody's withdrew 31 of 94 rated credits and assigned avg Ba1 (junk) on the remaining. 12 of 63 Moody's-rated names IG. SIGNIFICANT methodology disagreement.
test_3_split_rating_dispersion.verdict: VERIFIED — and this IS the alpha zone (S&P-investment-grade names that Moody's rates speculative-grade may trade wider than S&P-only-IG names that Moody's withdrew)

test_4_project_area_av_correlation_with_.method: Pull S&P/Fitch surveillance reports for ~10 Successor Agency TABs, extract MADS DSCR + AV growth + top-10 concentration. Test spread-vs-fundamentals.
test_4_project_area_av_correlation_with_.expected_if_intercept_is_structural: Spread correlation with project-area metrics; minimal correlation with host city GO spread
test_4_project_area_av_correlation_with_.observed: Atascadero (A+) has 4.89x MADS / 58% AV cushion / 13.5% top-10 / 5.6% AV growth — STRONG fundamentals. Riverside upgrade BBB->A- was on AV growth (project-area driver). Pattern consistent with intercept hypothesis but full quantitative test requires N>10 surveillance reports.
test_4_project_area_av_correlation_with_.verdict: PARTIAL — directionally supportive; not statistically tested
